data.name: Sahid
data.gender_notes: Sahid is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sahid is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sahidh' which means 'brave' or 'hero'. This name is associated with the warrior and brahmin communities and signifies courage, strength, and determination. The name Sahid carries the meaning “Warrior, Brave, Hero” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahid usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior, brave, hero and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sahid is a powerful name that carries the energy of the warrior archetype. It symbolizes the inner strength and courage needed to face challenges and overcome obstacles in life. It is a name that inspires bravery and encourages one to be a hero in their own life story.
data.etymology: Sahid belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior, Brave, Hero.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahid total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
